description: The project's pre-flight checklist registry. Listed read-only: it has no scalar setting, and checklist_version is pinned to 1 by scripts/validate-checklists.sh so it gets no bump rule.

keys.label: Checklist version
keys.description: Schema version, pinned to the integer 1 by the validator; never edited and never bumped by jenga config.

keys.label: Extra situations
keys.description: Extension names added to the four base phases (pre-commit, pre-task, pre-release, pre-reconcile); edited by hand.

keys.label: Checklist items
keys.description: The standing pre-flight items; edited by hand, and new ones are proposed through scripts/checklist.sh suggest, never by jenga config.
